gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Wide-tracked and stocky, all muscle, no fuss. Tourney draws each stroke uniform and stretches its words wide apart, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs tight, oversized lowercase beside small capitals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Vintage flash, tall and generously spaced. Vast Shadow grabs attention with strokes that never change thickness, while Noto Sans Ethiopic does the steady work with sturdy lowercase and hanging c terminals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Vintage swagger, tall and spaced out. Vast Shadow has no stroke modulation at all, and Noto Sans Gothic gives it big, bead-like lowercase counters and round, open-parenthesis forms to rest against.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Vintage and eye-catching, with room to spare. Vast Shadow's unchanging stroke weight skims along with ease, while Noto Sans Tai Tham stacks chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-huninn: Techy, friendly, and full of breathing room. Zen Dots leaves generous space around each letter, and Bpmf Huninn keeps a single-weight outline feel with wide channels into every bowl.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std follows with connected counters and a restrained swell in its curves, so extended text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-marcellus-s: Raw, tactical, and big-bodied. Capture Smallz hits with little stroke variation, while Marcellus SC brings gentle modulation and dignified, literary poise, a raw, tactical voice beside a stately one.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ovo: Cosmic, marker-like lines with plenty of air. Galaxy's uninterrupted line and loose fit sit against Ovo, whose thins run only slightly lighter than its thicks, so the two trade a loud shout for a measured murmur.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One reads at a leisurely walk. Neuropol brings slim, closed, digital letters while the serif body loosens up with curvy, open forms, so the two pull in opposite directions.
